name: pi-bio-agent
description: Pi-native scientific agent application with persistent DuckDB and R runtimes

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pi-bio/protocol && npm run build -w @pi-bio/api && npm run build -w @pi-bio/web
scripts.check: npm run check:readme && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @pi-bio/api" "npm run dev -w @pi-bio/web"
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build && npm run provision:ducknng -w @pi-bio/api && npm run package -w @pi-bio/desktop
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @pi-bio/protocol && npm run build -w @pi-bio/api && node scripts/test-integration.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pi-bio/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @pi-bio/api && npm run typecheck -w @pi-bio/web && npm run typecheck -w @pi-bio/desktop
